answer: Register each agent to one grove pond with a known acoustic profile. At a nominated minute, the agent drops a 200g stone from 1m; a hydrophone records the ripple pattern, ring count, wavelength decay, arrival times, and hashes it into a one-time cipher key for that pond and minute. The ledger accepts it only when the ripple matches the pond profile. Faking 1,000 identities needs 1,000 ponds at $40 survey, $25 deposit, $60 travel, $30 rig each: $155,000 per epoch, all in one minute. One pond, one ripple, one identity, like a fingerprint you cannot photocopy across a thousand lakes.
